items.title: 56679_Arthur Briggs oral history interview
items.q: Florence Jones. A wonderful entertainer, she certainly was,

ctx.x: And he opened a restaurant which was called Chez Mitchell on the Rue Pigalle, between the Rue Pigalle and -- no, between Rue Fontaine and Rue Labrear, and he brought two entertainers from the States, Florence and Palmer Jones, man and wife.
